verdict: PASS — all PRG1–PRG24 mathematical claims, exact original contracts, checked published applications and byte bindings independently reviewed.

per_claim_review.title: The precise coefficient category and tuple to be represented
per_claim_review.finding: The exact IsCO category, complete five-part tuple and RRObj universal property are stated on the original O, residual data, limit and TWAut; the source does not permit replacement by trace data.

per_claim_review.title: Automatic locality, residue compatibility and continuity
per_claim_review.finding: Every O-algebra map between the stated residue-compatible local rings is local and therefore adically continuous. The finite Artin quotients and coefficientwise continuity agree with Chenevier's continuous determinant functor.

per_claim_review.title: Finite power series and complete presentations
per_claim_review.finding: Finite-variable evaluation and uniqueness, relative O presentations, and completeness of finite modules/quotients are proved or matched to the exact Noetherian completion inputs; no coefficient flatness is presumed.

per_claim_review.title: The Witt coefficient ring maps to the given O
per_claim_review.finding: The unramified coefficient map W(k) to the original complete DVR is explicitly constructed by a separable residue generator and Hensel lifting. Equal-characteristic targets are permitted and injectivity is not asserted.

per_claim_review.title: The exact published determinant theorem used
per_claim_review.finding: Chenevier Proposition 3.3 with Lemma 3.2 and Remark 3.5/Proposition 3.7 is applied through condition F, with the full polynomial-law functor. This route has no ell>n or factorial-invertibility hypothesis.

per_claim_review.title: Relative determinant representability over the original O
per_claim_review.finding: The relative O universal determinant ring is the explicit proper completed power-series quotient. Its universal property follows on the original O targets, without using an unjustified flat base change; degree zero is treated separately.

per_claim_review.title: The finiteness and residual hypotheses on the actual cover
per_claim_review.finding: The actual Ph0 is open in the finitely generated profinite limit group. Open-subgroup Schreier gives condition F; pulled-back distinct residual characters remain distinct by surjectivity. No Adapted assumption is silently used here.

per_claim_review.title: The actual global determinant deformation ring
per_claim_review.finding: The global full determinant universal ring is installed on the original Ph0 and diagonal residual law, including the selected ell=3, n=4 case.

per_claim_review.title: Degree-one laws and compatibility on the exact subgroup mu
per_claim_review.finding: Degree-one full laws correspond to characters, and the prescribed character on the primary torsion subgroup has the correct residual value after passage to the topological abelianization.

per_claim_review.title: Every constrained local-character ring is constructed
per_claim_review.finding: The local degree-one universal ring is quotiented by precisely the original mu-value relations. These relations lie in the maximal ideal, and the resulting universal property is exactly IsPsi.

per_claim_review.title: Finite completed coproducts in the original category
per_claim_review.finding: The finite completed coproduct is the explicit disjoint-variable presentation with proper ideal and the full O-algebra universal property, including an empty family.

per_claim_review.title: The joint determinant and ordered local-character object
per_claim_review.finding: The common ring jointly represents the original global determinant and every ordered local character. It does not yet impose the six later patching relations.

per_claim_review.title: Construction of the complete original RRObj
per_claim_review.finding: Adding the original Unit coordinate, shifted ordered-root coordinates and Y coordinates gives exactly all five Tup fields and the full RRObj universal property.

per_claim_review.title: Independence of the presentation and arbitrary supplied W
per_claim_review.finding: Uniqueness of representing objects transports the construction to every given original RRObj; later maps are not restricted to a newly selected convenient representative.

per_claim_review.title: The ordered polynomial splitting algebra is finite free
per_claim_review.finding: The ordered polynomial splitting algebra is finite free of rank (n!)^q by successive monic adjunction and monic division, with repeated roots and zero rank included.

per_claim_review.title: A specified residue splitting selects a finite free local factor
per_claim_review.finding: The prescribed residue splitting selects one complete local factor. Lifted idempotents identify that factor with the corresponding localization, a nonzero finite projective and hence free module over the local base.

per_claim_review.title: Identification with the exact completed splitting algebra
per_claim_review.finding: The completed Sp quotient is identified with that exact local factor in both directions. Equality of maps uses all-series continuity, and ordinary generation by the original roots follows from the surjective finite splitting-algebra map.

per_claim_review.title: Actual Spo(A) and every finite-level splitting target
per_claim_review.finding: The original Spo(A) and finite-level SpAt satisfy the monic degree and residue factorization hypotheses. Adapted is retained for the finite-level residual comparison, and original ordered roots are preserved.

per_claim_review.title: Every actual finite-level datum is a tuple over its original ring
per_claim_review.finding: For every level N, the original finite-level D, psi, Unit, roots and Y values form the literal Tup. Residual equality uses the original modH and Adapted statements and all local compatibility fields.

per_claim_review.title: The specialization tuple over the exact ordered splitting algebra
per_claim_review.finding: The specialization tuple uses the actual Spo(A), the original pulled determinant and local characters, exact ordered roots, original parameter image, and zero outer variables.

per_claim_review.title: The universal section with the original weight coordinates
per_claim_review.finding: The universal section evaluates the original weight coordinates c*psi-1, original Unit and Y entries. Residual identities place every argument in the maximal ideal, and nested power-series uniqueness is proved.

per_claim_review.title: All finite-level maps and identities on every series
per_claim_review.finding: Every rho_N arises from the full RRObj tuple property. The exact original weight and Y identities then yield rho_N(s_infty(z))=s_N(z) for every series z, not only polynomial generators.

per_claim_review.title: The exact specialization map and constant-coefficient identity
per_claim_review.finding: The specialization map has the exact original determinant, local characters, Unit and root images. The original segmentWeightExponent identity yields pi(s_infty(z))=Binc(lambda(constantCoeff(z))) for every series.

per_claim_review.title: Complete RMaps and the exact remaining patching contract
per_claim_review.finding: All ten RMaps fields are supplied on one original RRObj and original family, with the stated Adapted guard. Patched modules, support completions and the later selected-point join remain separate inputs in this packet.
